description: Unit tests for the SessionServerAppManager component, testing session server lifecycle, state changes, error handling, and communication mechanisms.

classes.name: SessionServerAppManagerTests
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing SessionServerAppManager functionalities.

methods.name: GetConnectionInfoShouldReturnEmptyStringForNotRunningSessionServer
methods.description: Tests that the connection info is empty when the session server is not running.

methods.name: InitiateApplicationShouldReturnFalseWhenNotRunningSessionServerIsSwitchedToNotRunning
methods.description: Verifies that initiating application returns false when session server is not in a running state.

methods.name: InitiateApplicationShouldReturnFalseWhenSessionServerFailedToLaunch
methods.description: Checks that initiation fails if the session server fails to launch.

methods.name: InitiateApplicationShouldReturnFalseWhenSessionServerFailedToConnect
methods.description: Checks that initiation fails if the session server fails to connect.

methods.name: InitiateApplicationShouldReturnTrueWhenSessionServerIsLaunched
methods.description: Verifies successful initiation when the session server launches properly.

methods.name: InitiateApplicationShouldReturnFalseWhenCalledForRunningApplication
methods.description: Ensures that re-initiating an already running application returns false.

methods.name: GetConnectionInfoShouldReturnProperSocket
methods.description: Tests that the correct socket path is returned after launching the session server.

methods.name: SetSessionServerStateShouldReturnFalseWhenAppIsNotLaunched
methods.description: Checks that setting session server state fails if the app isn't launched.

methods.name: SetSessionServerStateShouldReturnFalseWhenUnableToSendMessage
methods.description: Verifies failure to change state when message sending fails.

methods.name: SetSessionServerStateShouldReturnTrueWhenStateIsChanged
methods.description: Verifies successful state change.

methods.name: StateObserverShouldBeInformedAboutStateChangeToInactive
methods.description: Checks that the observer is notified about state changes to inactive.

methods.name: SessionServerAppManagerShouldRemoveApplicationWhenSetConfigurationFails
methods.description: Tests removal of application when configuration setting fails.

methods.name: SessionServerAppManagerShouldRemoveApplicationWhenNotRunningIndicationIsReceived
methods.description: Ensures application is removed upon receiving not running indication.

methods.name: SessionServerAppManagerShouldForwardErrorIndicationOfRunningApp
methods.description: Verifies forwarding of error indications from the session server.

methods.name: SessionServerAppManagerShouldRespawnPreloadedServerWhenErrorIndicationIsReceived
methods.description: Checks that a preloaded server is respawned after error indication.

methods.name: SessionServerAppManagerShouldSetNewLogLevel
methods.description: Verifies that log level can be set successfully.

methods.name: SessionServerAppManagerShouldFailToSetNewLogLevel
methods.description: Checks failure to set log level.

methods.name: PreloadedServerShouldFailToLaunch
methods.description: Tests failure scenario for preloaded server launch.

methods.name: PreloadedServerShouldFailToConnect
methods.description: Tests failure scenario for preloaded server connection.

methods.name: PreloadedServerShouldLaunch
methods.description: Verifies successful launch of preloaded server.

methods.name: SessionServerAppManagerShouldFailToConfigurePreloadedAppDueToAppError
methods.description: Tests configuration failure due to app error.

methods.name: SessionServerAppManagerShouldFailToConfigurePreloadedAppDueToServerError
methods.description: Tests configuration failure due to server error.

methods.name: SessionServerAppManagerShouldConfigure
methods.description: Verifies successful configuration of preloaded server.

methods.name: SessionServerAppManagerShouldHandleAck
methods.description: Tests handling of acknowledgment messages.

methods.name: SessionServerAppManagerShouldSendPingEvents
methods.description: Verifies sending of ping events.

methods.name: SessionServerAppManagerShouldFailToSendPingEvents
methods.description: Checks failure scenario for sending ping events.
